| `title`       | `string`                                          |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Activity log')`               | Page title. Defaults to "Activity log" so a bare manifest entry still renders meaningfully.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

| `showTitle`   | `boolean`                                         |          | `true`                                                      | Whether to render the inline page header VISIBLY. Defaults to true: unlike CnIndexPage (which surfaces the title in its sidebar header when this is false), a logs page has no sidebar fallback, so a false default left the page with no heading at all. Setting it to false is now safe for accessibility either way — the `&lt;h1&gt;` is still rendered visually-hidden, so the `&lt;main&gt;` landmark keeps its accessible heading (WCAG 2.4.6 / 1.3.1). |

Required (with `schema`) for store-backed mode. Changing it after mount requires a remount — CnPageRenderer keys the dispatched page on register+schema, so a manifest page swap already remounts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

| `source`      | `string`                                          |          | `''`                                                        | Custom log source URL — used when `register`+`schema` is not set.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

Pass either an array of strings (treated as keys + auto-labels) OR an array of `{ key, label, sortable, width }` objects.                                                                                             |

Store mode only.                                                                                                                              |

Inert while `sortKey` is null.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

| `fixedLayout` | `boolean`                                         |          | `false`                                                     | Make the columns' declared `width` authoritative (`table-layout: fixed`) instead of a hint the browser may override from cell content. Worth setting on a log table: message text and long unbreakable values like a PHP FQCN otherwise dictate the column widths between them.
